# Aaghran Ghosh

> Principal PM and AI builder based in Bangalore. Builds AI products that work in production — MCP integrations, agentic pipelines, and the product thinking around them.

Principal PM at ThoughtSpot, building Spotter (natural language search and agentic analytics for enterprises). Also ships personal AI products and writes about AI agents, MCP, and slow travel.

## Site

- [Home](https://aaghran.com/): Overview, selected projects, writing, and contact
- [Projects](https://aaghran.com/projects/): Side projects and open-source work
- [Work](https://aaghran.com/work/): Professional experience
- [Writing](https://aaghran.com/writing/): AI/product essays (Substack) and travel writing (Medium / WanderingBong)

## Projects

- [WanderingBong](https://aaghran.com/projects/wanderingbong/): Slow-travel blog (since 2015), now MCP-connected for content ops
- [Eidetic](https://aaghran.com/projects/eidetic/): Capture-and-search memory — Chrome extension, mobile app, FastAPI + pgvector, MCP server
- [Roami](https://aaghran.com/projects/roami/): Travel journaling app designed and shipped end-to-end
- [Worldview](https://aaghran.com/projects/worldview/): Live satellite globe from CelesTrak orbital data
- [Lyaadh](https://aaghran.com/projects/lyaadh/): Brand around productive laziness (ShortCuts, Dokan, Escapes)
- [BIRD → Snowflake](https://aaghran.com/projects/bird-loader/): Open-source Snowflake loader for the BIRD NL-to-SQL benchmark
